1046.description: A cable row where the handle sits higher than usual, pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back.
instructions: Set a cable handle at about head height and take a stable stance.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly with arms extended.
Pull toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

1110.description: From a forearm plank with feet in the straps, you rock your body back and forth like a saw to challenge the core.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set up on your forearms.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Shift your body backward by pushing through the forearms.
Rock forward past the starting point in a short controlled motion.
Keep your hips level, do not let your lower back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

1174.description: An easier knee version of the diamond push-up that targets the triceps with hands close together.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

1238.description: A seated cable row using a bent bar. The angled bar suits many wrists while you train the back.
instructions: Sit at a low cable station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the bent bar with both hands.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your back straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms slowly without rounding forward.

1302.description: Throw a medicine ball forward from your chest with a quick push, then catch it and repeat. It builds explosive pushing power in the chest and arms.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the medicine ball at chest level.
Extend your arms forward, pushing the medicine ball away from your chest with force.
As you release the ball, follow through with your arms and torso, transferring your weight from your back foot to your front foot.
Catch the ball as it rebounds off the wall or partner, and immediately repeat the movement.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将健身球保持在胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，用力将药球推离胸部。
当你释放球时，用你的手臂和躯干将球从后脚转移到前脚。
当球从墙壁或伙伴身上反弹时接住球，并立即重复该动作。
继续进行所需的重复次数。

1366.description: A yoga pose where you lift your chest and thighs off the floor on straight arms. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended behind you.
Place your hands on the floor next to your lower ribs, fingers pointing forward.
Press your hands firmly into the floor and straighten your arms, lifting your torso and thighs off the ground.
Roll your shoulders back and down, opening your chest and lifting your gaze towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few breaths, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在地板上，双腿伸到身后。
将双手放在下肋骨旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
双手用力按在地板上，伸直手臂，将躯干和大腿抬离地面。
向后和向下转动肩膀，打开胸部，将目光转向天花板。
保持这个姿势几次呼吸，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1430.description: A chest dip done on a dip station with a forward lean. It works the lower chest, triceps and front shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the dip bars to a height that allows you to comfortably grip them.
Stand between the bars and place your hands on each bar, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Jump up and straighten your arms, supporting your body weight on the bars.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles behind you.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your chest up and your shoulders down.
Continue lowering until your shoulders are below your elbows or until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Push through your palms and extend your elbows to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将倾斜杆调整到您可以舒适地握住它们的高度。
站在杠铃之间，将双手放在每个杠铃上，距离略宽于肩宽。
跳起来并伸直双臂，将体重支撑在杠上。
弯曲膝盖并将脚踝交叉在身后。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持胸部向上，肩膀向下。
继续降低，直到肩膀低于肘部或直到您感到胸部有拉伸感。
推动手掌并伸展肘部，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1494.description: A seated pose with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out. It opens the inner thighs and hips.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall out to the sides.
Hold onto your ankles or feet with your hands.
Sit up tall and lengthen your spine.
Gently press your knees down towards the floor, feeling a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
To release, slowly bring your knees back up and extend your legs.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
弯曲膝盖，将脚底并拢，让膝盖向两侧倾斜。
用手抓住脚踝或脚。
坐直并拉长脊柱。
轻轻地将膝盖压向地板，感觉大腿内侧有拉伸感。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
要放松，请慢慢抬起膝盖并伸展双腿。

1558.description: A wall squat made harder by holding dumbbells. It keeps your back supported while loading the legs.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean your back against a wall.
Walk your feet forward so your knees stay over your ankles when you squat.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat against the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.

1622.description: A one-arm dumbbell press with your palm facing you. It shifts focus to the upper chest and biceps.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing towards your body.
Place your feet flat on the ground and keep your back straight.
Raise the dumbbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Press the dumbbell upwards until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将双脚平放在地面上，并保持背部挺直。
将哑铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1686.description: A squat with an overhead reach and a twist. It trains the legs and mobilizes the torso.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, raise your arms overhead and twist your torso to one side.
Return to the starting position and repeat the squat, this time twisting your torso to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides with each squat repetition.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂举过头顶并将躯干扭转到一侧。
返回起始位置并重复下蹲，这次将躯干扭转到另一侧。
每次深蹲重复时继续交替进行。

1750.description: An explosive chest throw with a medicine ball while lying on your back. Develops fast pressing power in the triceps and chest.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the medicine ball with both hands, extending your arms straight up above your chest.
Lower the medicine ball towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Explosively push the medicine ball upwards, extending your arms fully and throwing the ball as high as possible.
Catch the medicine ball and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住药球，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
将健身球降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
爆发性地将药球向上推，充分伸展双臂并将球扔得尽可能高。
接住药球并重复所需的重复次数。

1814.description: Extending your arm and turning the palm outward stretches the muscles that bend your elbow. It targets the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1878.description: Cross one leg behind the other to stretch the outer hip and thigh.
instructions: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1942.description: A standing side lean that stretches the iliotibial band along the outside of the thigh.
instructions: Stand next to a wall or support and cross your outer leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the wall and reach the outer arm overhead until the outside of the hip and thigh stretches.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2198.description: A machine-based triceps extension that lets you load the back of the arm with a steady, guided path.
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without lifting your shoulders.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2326.description: A bent-over row with an overhand grip, building the muscles of the mid and upper back.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang with palms facing your legs.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Keep your elbows close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid jerking with your torso.

2710.description: Pulling a heavy truck with a rope over a distance, building leg drive and grip.
instructions: Stand facing away from the truck with the rope held across your body.
Lean forward and dig your feet in.
Take short, powerful steps driving through the legs.
Keep your core braced and the rope close.
Pull the full distance, then rest.

2774.description: Bending the knee to bring the heel toward the glutes, working the back of the thigh.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Bend the other knee to bring your heel up toward your glutes.
Keep your thighs side by side, pause, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2838.description: A pedalling leg movement lying on your back that works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs and curl your shoulders up.
Extend one leg while bringing the opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

2902.description: A rear lunge combined with a row using a power sled. Works legs and back together.
instructions: Hold the sled handles with arms extended and feet together.
Step back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee.
As you rise, row the handles toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return to standing and extend your arms.
Alternate legs on each rep.

2966.description: A squat with dumbbells held at your shoulders. The front load keeps your chest upright and challenges the quads and core.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

3030.description: A split-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It works each leg on its own and builds strength and balance.
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3094.description: The classic jump where your arms and legs swing out and back. A simple full-body warm-up that raises your heart rate fast.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3158.description: A bent-over standing row with a close grip, pulling the hands toward your body. It builds the upper back and the muscles that squeeze the shoulder blades together.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, gripping the bar or handles with a close grip.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将双臂伸直在身前，紧紧抓住杆或手柄。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3222.description: A shallow squat followed by a jump, with the arms swinging for momentum. It trains the leg power and gets the heart rate up.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性跳跃，伸展臀部和膝盖，同时摆动手臂以获得动力。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个重复动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

3286.description: A muscle up with added weight, pulling from a hang up and over the bar into a dip position. It is an advanced move for lats, chest and triceps.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest reaches the bar, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你到达动作的最高点时，改变你的握力，使你的手掌朝向你。
继续拉起自己，直到胸部到达杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将自己放回到起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

3350.description: A sideways lunge against cable tension, training glutes, inner thighs and side to side strength.
instructions: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand sideways to the stack.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and feet flat.
Push off your bent leg to return to center.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

3414.description: Rotate your upper body while lying down to loosen the mid-back.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms stretched in front of you.
Keep your knees stacked.
Lift the top arm and open it across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Return the arm to the start.
Do 10 reps, then switch sides.

3478.description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the left.
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the left.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

3542.description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a T shape. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lean forward and let your arms hang straight down, perpendicular to the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, forming a 'T' shape with your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
向前倾斜，让手臂笔直向下垂，垂直于地板。
保持手臂伸直，将它们向两侧举起，直到与地板平行，与身体形成“T”形。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3606.description: A crunch on a stability ball combined with extending the legs for a deep ab workout.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up as you extend one leg.
Lower slowly and bend the knee.
Alternate legs for the set.

3670.description: A weighted sit-up on a decline bench. It trains the abs through a long range.
instructions: Lie flat on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward until your torso is perpendicular to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离长凳，向前卷曲，直到躯干垂直于地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3734.description: A one-leg deadlift with the back foot lightly touching the floor for support, so you can focus on the working leg.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and stand with one foot slightly behind, toes on the ground as a kickstand.
Hinge at the hips over your front leg.
Lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive through your front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3798.description: A standing forward punch against a resistance band. It trains your chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Stand in a staggered stance with a braced core.
Punch one hand forward and rotate your torso slightly.
Return the hand and punch with the other side.
Keep the movement quick but controlled.

3862.description: An explosive forward jump against band resistance that builds power in the legs and hips.
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your hips.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump forward as far as you can against the band.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

3926.description: A slow side-lying leg circle that works the outer hip and mobilizes the hip joint.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked.
Lift the top leg slightly.
Draw small circles in the air.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your pelvis still.
Switch sides.

3990.description: A seated overhead press with a narrow grip on the EZ bar. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit upright holding the EZ bar with a close grip at your chest.
Brace your core.
Press the bar overhead.
Lower it back to chest height.
Keep your ribs down.

4054.description: Overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell while seated on a stability ball. The ball adds a core challenge.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball and hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arm back up.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

4118.description: A jump squat with hands behind your head for an explosive leg workout.
instructions: Stand with your hands behind your head and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly on bent knees.
Go straight into the next rep.

4182.description: A wide rowing motion with a resistance band. It strengthens the rear shoulders.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles.
Step back for tension.
Pull your hands out to the sides with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Keep your torso upright.

4246.description: A squat holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The angled bar helps keep you upright and easy on the back.
instructions: Load the landmine bar and hold the end against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace and squat down, keeping your chest tall.
Go as deep as you can with a flat back.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep your elbows pointing down.

4310.description: A pilates exercise where you scissor your straight legs while holding the raised one. It trains the abs and tests hamstring flexibility.
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend one leg straight up and the other hovering low.
Hold the raised leg with both hands and pulse twice toward you.
Switch legs and repeat, keeping your torso steady.
Keep your lower back anchored throughout.

4374.description: A standing cable fly from a low pulley, sweeping the arms up and across one at a time. It trains the upper chest.
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles.
Take a small step forward with a slight lean.
Sweep one arm up and across toward the center of your chest.
Return slowly.
Alternate sides.

4438.description: A low-impact version of the jumping jack where you step out instead of jumping.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead.
Step it back as you lower your arms.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

4566.description: A cable kickback with palms facing in, isolating the triceps.
instructions: Set a low cable with a neutral grip handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Pin your upper arm against your side.
Hold the handle with your palm facing in.
Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

4630.description: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg across your body and out to the side to loosen the hips.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Shift onto one leg.
Swing the other leg across your body, then out to the side.
Keep your torso upright and the swing controlled.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

4694.description: An overhead triceps extension with a band. It isolates the back of the arms.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4758.description: A reverse lunge followed by a row. It trains the legs and the back in one flowing movement.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Hinge your torso slightly forward with a flat back.
Row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, push through the front foot to stand, and switch legs.

4822.description: A Romanian deadlift that finishes with an explosive jump and shrug. It trains power through the hips and traps.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and jump as you shrug your shoulders.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset into the hinge and repeat.

4886.description: A hip raise done lying flat on the floor. It works the lower abs by lifting your hips with a controlled curl.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or under your hips.
Raise your legs so they point to the ceiling.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips a few centimetres.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep the motion small and controlled.

4950.description: A forward lunge with a shorter step and an upright torso. It emphasizes the quads.
instructions: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a short step forward.
Lower straight down, keeping your torso upright.
Keep the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

5014.description: Deadlift with a pause just off the floor. It strengthens the start of the pull and teaches strong positions.
instructions: Stand with the bar over midfoot and grip just outside your legs.
Brace your core and flatten your back.
Lift the bar a few inches and hold the pause for a second.
Keep your back flat, then drive through your legs to stand tall.
Lower the bar under control.

5078.description: Sit tall and open your elbows wide like a clam to stretch the front of the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall with your fingers lightly behind your head.
Start with your elbows pointing forward.
Slowly open your elbows out and back as far as is comfortable.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.

5142.description: Pull a Smith machine bar from the knees up to your shoulders. The fixed track helps you learn the hang clean pattern.
instructions: Stand at the bar with it hanging at your knees, hands just outside your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Pull your elbows high and catch the bar on your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to your knees and repeat.

5206.description: A second variation of the kneeling band crunch. It loads the abs through the full crunch range.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the band at your forehead or beside your head.
Pull your elbows toward your knees as you curl down.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly while keeping the tension.

5334.description: A sit-up with a cross-body twist, a second variation. It works the abs and obliques together.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

5398.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the sole of the foot. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Stand or sit with the roller under one foot.
Place the roller under the sole of the foot and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll the sole from heel to toes, then switch feet.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5526.description: Hooping around your waist with a hula hoop for light cardio and core engagement.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding the hoop against your lower back.
Give it a push and start swinging your hips in circles.
Keep the motion smooth and steady.
Stay tall with a braced core.
Continue for a set time, then switch direction.

5846.description: A standing crunch that brings your elbow across to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and rotate your torso.
Bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides for the set.

5910.description: A sumo deadlift with chains hung on the bar, so the load gets heavier as you stand up. It builds the glutes, inner thighs and back.
instructions: Hang chains on a barbell and stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Push the floor away and drive your knees out.
Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.

5974.description: A mix of quick hops and direction changes that builds explosive power and agility.
instructions: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Land softly with bent knees.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

6038.description: A kick-back using the Smith machine bar under the foot, to target the glutes.
instructions: Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.

6294.description: A prone backbend with one foot pulled toward your hip. It stretches the quads and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your belly, propped on your forearms.
Bend one knee and reach back to hold that foot.
Gently press the foot toward your hip.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

6358.description: Wrist curls with an EZ bar held in front of you, targeting the muscles on the underside of your forearms.
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still and close to your body.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar a short distance.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.

6486.description: Bent over with a band, you raise your arms out wide to work the back of your shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand on a band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6550.description: A push-up with your hands on a Smith bar, making it easier than a floor push-up while still training your chest.
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about waist height and rack it securely.
Place your hands on the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up to straight arms.

6742.description: A donkey kickback on a cable that sends the leg back and slightly out. It focuses on the glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Get on all fours facing the machine.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Kick the leg back and slightly out on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

6806.description: A variation of the seated overhead press and Russian twist combo with feet off the floor. It works the trunk and shoulders.
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead and lower them.
Twist your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your chest tall and breathe steadily.

8342.description: A standing drill that rotates the arms outward while drawing the shoulder blades back. It wakes up the rotator cuff and upper back.
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your palms facing forward.
Rotate your forearms outward and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

8662.description: A close-grip incline cable press using a V bar that trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a cable and V bar anchored low behind you.
Hold the bar at chest height with a narrow grip.
Press upward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.
Keep your back against the pad.

9494.description: A hip hinge using a belt machine so the weight hangs from your hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes without loading the back.
instructions: Wear the belt and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat with smooth control.

9878.description: A squat holding a low cable in the crook of your elbows in front of you. The front load keeps you upright and works the quads, glutes and core.
instructions: Attach a bar or handle to a low cable and hook it in the bends of your elbows, close to your chest.
Stand facing away from the stack with your feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your elbows tucked and the load close to your body.

9942.description: A standing stretch with your legs crossed that lengthens the sides of the trunk. It loosens the obliques and waist.
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

10198.description: A sled leg press done one leg at a time, with a slow lowering phase to build leg strength.
instructions: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.

10326.description: A fast move from a plank to a squat jump position, raising the heart rate and training the legs and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.

10646.description: A chest-supported row on an incline lever machine. The support keeps your back steady so the upper back does the work.
instructions: Lie chest-down on the incline pad and grab the handles.
Let your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your head neutral.

10710.description: Crunch while holding a plate. It works the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold the plate on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly.

10902.description: A slow lowering phase of a one-arm pull-up. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
instructions: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.

11286.description: A half kneeling side lunge with a kettlebell. It opens the inner thigh and hips while loading the legs.
instructions: Start in a half kneeling position holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Straighten the front leg to the side as you shift your weight back.
Feel a stretch in your inner thigh.
Return to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

11798.description: A flowing bent-over arm sweep from back to side to front that warms up and strengthens the rear and side shoulders.
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down.
Sweep both arms back behind your hips.
Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.

0022.description: Lying on a bench, you lower a barbell overhead in an arc and then press it back up. Works the lats, chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the ground.
Hold the barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, lower the barbell behind your head in an arc-like motion until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the motion and press the barbell back to the starting position above your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头朝一端，双脚着地。
旋前握住杠铃（手掌背向您），并将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持手臂伸直，以弧形动作将杠铃降低到脑后，直到感觉到背阔肌有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作，将杠铃推回到胸部上方的起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0086.description: A seated overhead press with the bar lowered behind your head. Works the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it down to shoulder level, behind your head.
Press the barbell upward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，杠铃间距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，然后将其降至与肩同高，位于头后。
向上推杠铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
将杠铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0150.description: A lat pulldown on the cable machine with a straight bar. Builds the lats.
instructions: Adjust the cable pulley to a high position and attach a straight bar.
Sit facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the bar down towards your chest, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆滑轮调整至较高位置并安装直杆。
面向缆绳机坐着，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
稍微向后倾斜，挺胸，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将杠铃向下拉向胸部，用肘部引导并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0214.description: A seated cable row that alternates between arms. It works the back one side at a time with a full squeeze each rep.
instructions: Sit on a bench facing a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handle with one hand and keep your arm fully extended in front of you.
Pull the handle towards your body, retracting your shoulder blade and keeping your elbow close to your side.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your back muscles.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Alternate between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，面对缆绳机，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
用一只手抓住手柄，并将手臂完全伸展到身前。
将手柄拉向身体，缩回肩胛骨并保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
双臂交替进行所需的重复次数。

0278.description: A push-up with your feet on a stability ball, so your hands sit lower than your feet. It challenges the upper chest, shoulders and balance.
instructions: Place your shins or feet on a stability ball and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up without letting your hips sag.
Brace your core to keep the ball steady.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.

0342.description: A one-arm lying dumbbell press. The weight lowers to the chest side and presses up, working the pecs and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back supported and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing towards your feet.
Extend your arm straight up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Slowly lower the dumbbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，背部支撑，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝向脚部。
将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0406.description: Standing tall with dumbbells at your sides, you lift your shoulders toward your ears. It builds the upper traps and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your arms straight and let the dumbbells hang by your sides.
Raise your shoulders as high as possible, as if you are trying to touch your ears with your shoulders.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持手臂伸直，让哑铃垂在身体两侧。
尽可能高地抬高肩膀，就像试图用肩膀触碰耳朵一样。
保持收缩一秒钟，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0470.description: A crunch where you bring a hand toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee up.
Reach the opposite hand toward that knee.
Lower and repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

0534.description: Hold a kettlebell close to your chest and squat down between your hips. A friendly squat variation for legs, glutes and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住壶铃靠近胸部。
保持胸部挺直，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖和臀部，将身体降低至蹲姿。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0598.description: Seated on a machine, you squeeze your knees together against pads. Trains the inner thighs.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grasp the handles for stability.
Engage your adductor muscles and slowly bring your legs together, squeezing your inner thighs.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将脚放在脚踏板上并抓住手柄以保持稳定。
收紧内收肌，慢慢将双腿并拢，挤压大腿内侧。
在收缩高峰时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0662.description: The classic push-up from a high plank. Works the chest, shoulders, triceps and core in one move.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将身体压向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0726.description: A glute bridge on one leg. It builds glute strength and hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Extend one leg straight.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

0790.description: Lifting a bent knee out to the side while standing. It works the outer hip and glutes and trains balance.
instructions: Stand tall and hold onto a support if needed.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend the other knee.
Lift the bent knee out to the side without leaning.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

0854.description: A standing hand squeeze holding weights, squeezing the hands together. It works the forearms and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight in each hand.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, palms facing each other.
Squeeze your hands together as hard as you can, engaging your forearms.
Hold the squeeze for a few seconds, then release.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个重物。
将双臂伸直在身前，手掌相对。
尽可能用力将双手握在一起，用力接触前臂。
按住挤压几秒钟，然后松开。
重复所需的重复次数。

0982.description: A side-lying clam-style move with a band around the knees that fires up the outer hip and glute muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.
